verdicts.reason: A: the layout runs left to right sensibly (logo, can, headline, date, pills), but the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a small pill lost among the badges. On the right, the details text wraps to leave an orphaned '9', and the missing-asset placeholder overlaps it; the 'Reserve' line is tiny. B is worse. The sun icon collides with the SOLSTICE wordmark, and the subtitle runs straight on from the TASTINGS pill into the time/venue details as one cramped italic line. The 'Reserve a spot' text floats tiny in the centre, the headline is jammed against the top edge, and the planet shape crowds 'Saturday 21 June'.
